name: Clarity Editing
description: Edits text for clarity by identifying and fixing ambiguous sentences, unclear references, jargon, convoluted syntax, and logical gaps. Produces tracked-change markup with clarity-focused revisions. Use when the user asks to make text clearer, easier to understand, less confusing, or more accessible to a specific audience. Do NOT use for conciseness (use conciseness-editing), structural changes (use structural-editing), or tone shifts (use tone-adjustment).
